Why Codex?

Starting a business is hard. Getting online shouldn't be hard. Codex helps new businesses establish a professional digital presence without making the process complicated.

About Us

We’re Codex.

We started Codex because we know that getting a business online can feel like a lot, especially when you’re just starting out.

Our goal is simple: help businesses get a good-looking website without making the whole process difficult.

You tell us about your business, what you want, and how you want it to look. We take it from there and build you a website that fits your business.

We’re still growing too, and that’s part of what makes Codex exciting. We want to grow alongside the businesses we work with.

Simple websites. Big beginnings.

How to Get Your Website

Getting your business online is simple. Just follow these four steps and Codex will take care of the website.

1

Send Us an Email

Click “Build With Codex” and tell us about your business, what you do, and what kind of website you want.

2

Share Your Details

Send your business name, services, preferred style or colours, contact details, and any other information you want on the site.

3

We Build It

Codex creates a modern, responsive website based on your business and the details you provide.

4

Launch Your Website 🚀

Check your website, request any changes, and once everything looks good, we’ll help get your website online.
